members.title: FDA orders new warning labels on Ozempic, Wegovy over rare risk of permanent vision loss
members.description: The Food and Drug Administration now requires warning labels on Ozempic, Wegovy and other GLP-1 drugs over a rare eye condition tied to vision loss.

members.title: STAT+: GLP-1s are given an FDA warning for rare eye condition risk
members.description: The FDA warned that GLP-1 drugs carry a potential risk of a rare but serious eye condition sometimes referred to as an “eye stroke.”
